rationale: The final Total Investments row of the filing's schedule of investments reports exact fair value of $29,499.3 million. The balance sheet independently presents the same grand total rounded to $29,499 million and identifies its three included classes: non-controlled/non-affiliate, non-controlled affiliate, and controlled affiliate. Thus the companyfacts value captured the full grand total, not only a non-affiliated subtotal.
